name: BlockOrigin
description: Gulf of Mexico block identification of where the pipeline originates.

name: Commodity
description: Primary commodity carried by the pipeline system.

name: County
description: The county in which the pipeline segment is located.

name: DeletedDate
requirements: Value should be in the RFC3339 format. Example: 2021-01-01
description: Date the record was deleted.

name: Diameter_IN
description: The outside diameter of the pipeline (inches).

name: ENVBasin
description: The basin in which the pipeline segment is located.

name: ENVPlay
description: The play in which the pipeline segment is located.

name: ENVRegion
description: The region in which the pipeline segment is located.

name: FacilityOrigin
description: Name of facility where pipeline originates.

name: FinalOperator
description: The operator of the pipeline. The name of the operator as it appears in Prism (Enverus derived operator).

name: FinalTicker
description: The pipeline operators ticker symbol. The stock exchange ticker for publicly traded companies or the shortened/other company name for private companies.

name: Geom_Line
description: Well-known text string. Provides the line geometry coordinates of the pipeline.

name: GeomBbox_Poly
description: Geometry representing the bounding box of the pipeline.

name: InterstateCode
description: Identifies if a pipeline segment is Interstate or Intrastate (YES = Interstate; NO = Intrastate).

name: Length_MI
description: Length of pipeline segment (miles).

name: StateProvince
description: The state or province in which the pipeline segment is located.

name: Status
description: The operational status of the pipeline segment.

name: SubsystemName
description: The subsystem name of the pipeline - name for a smaller sub-section of the pipeline.

name: SystemName
description: The name of the pipeline system.

name: SystemType
description: The system type of the pipeline.

name: UpdatedDate
requirements: Value should be in the RFC3339 format. Example: 2021-01-01
description: Date the record was updated.

name: UniqueID
description: Unique string ID. Used as a consistent identifier for pipeline segments.
